g.data-semantic-relation: lock clean support and its coverage
g.data-must-show: few reference defect image/mask、normal target、placement mask、real/synthetic split 分開 | 資料來源可追溯 | 邊界提示：少量 reference 不等於完整 defect distribution。
g.data-not-claim: 少量 reference 不等於完整 defect distribution。
g.title: 真實 reference、mask、split

svg.text: 以 LoRA 調整缺陷概念

g.data-semantic-relation: adapt a declared concept without replacing raw evidence
g.data-must-show: defect token、LoRA rank／weights 連到指定 inpainting checkpoint | attention adaptation 可見 | 邊界提示：LoRA concept 不是真實缺陷標籤。
g.data-not-claim: LoRA concept 不是真實缺陷標籤。
g.title: LoRA 學 defect concept
